points.description: States any valid application of broaching, e.g. machining gears, splines, keyways/slots, custom or precision machining in automotive industry, or making slots for support.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if vague but on track (e.g. says it is used for shaping or finishing holes/surfaces in industry without a specific application).

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming any one reasonable application of broaching (gears, splines, slots/keyways, precision or automotive machining) in any wording. Give 1 mark for a vague answer that is generally about shaping or finishing with no specific use. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong applications. Extra remarks do not cost marks.
